menu.title: Menu
menu.description: Create your restaurant menu with categories, dishes, photos and prices.

photoEnhancement.hint: Processing starts when you press the button. The original stays in your media library.

eveningWood.name: Dark wood
eveningWood.description: A wooden board replaces the plate, with warm evening restaurant lighting. Soups use a ceramic bowl.

daylightCeramic.name: Light ceramic
daylightCeramic.description: Ivory ceramic tableware, a limestone table and soft natural daylight.

darkSlate.name: Dark slate
darkSlate.description: A slate serving board, dark stone and soft side lighting. Soups use dark ceramic tableware.

photoEnhancement.review: Compare the dish with the original: AI may change details.
photoEnhancement.notConfigured: Photo enhancement is not connected yet. Please try again later.
photoEnhancement.rateLimit: The service is temporarily busy. Please try again shortly.
photoEnhancement.signIn: Please sign in again to improve this photo.
photoEnhancement.storageLimit: Your storage is full. Free up space and press Apply again.
photoEnhancement.processingTimeout: Your photo is still processing. Wait and press Apply again; no new generation is needed.
photoEnhancement.timeout: Processing took too long. Please try again.
photoEnhancement.error: Could not improve the photo. Please try again.
photoEnhancement.saveError: Could not save the result. Please try applying it again.

menu.title: Menu

appearance.title: Menu appearance
appearance.moodDescription: Changes the color of photos and ambient menu light.
appearance.textureDescription: Adds a subtle texture around the menu.

typography.title: Menu typography
typography.bodySample: Good taste starts with the details. Choose what feels right.
typography.hint: The font changes all menu text, including descriptions and buttons.

menu.currencyHint: Changing the currency changes its label, not the amounts. Review your prices after changing it.

categoryForm.title: New category
categoryForm.description: The category will appear on this page. Add its dishes next.
categoryForm.error: Could not add the category. Check the menu limit and try again.
categoryForm.deleteHint: An empty category will disappear from every menu page.

dishForm.recommendHint: This dish appears in the character’s suggestions on this menu page.
dishForm.added: Dish added. You can add another.
dishForm.saveError: Could not save the dish. Check its category and the menu limit.
dishForm.deleteDescription: The dish and its photo will disappear from every menu page.
dishForm.empty: No dishes in this category yet
dishForm.emptyHint: Add a name and price. The other fields can wait.

menu.invalidPrice: Enter a non-negative price with up to two decimal places, no more than 9,999,999.99.
menu.removeCategoryHint: Move or delete this category’s dishes before deleting the category.
menu.draftHint: Only visible categories and dishes with a name and a valid price appear in the menu.
menu.emptyEditor: Add a category and a dish with a name and price in the Menu section.
menu.limits: Up to {categories} categories and {dishes} dishes per menu.

pages.title: Menu pages
pages.backgroundHint: Choose a photo. Darkening and subtle scroll movement are applied automatically.
pages.description: Set the page name and address independently.
pages.name: Page name
pages.pathHint: For example, /drinks. Use lowercase Latin letters, numbers and hyphens. After publication, changing the path will break the previous link and its QR code.
pages.homePathHint: The home page always opens at /.
pages.makeHomeHint: This page will use / and the previous home page will use {path}. After publication, the home QR will open the new home page, and the QR for {path} will open the previous one.
pages.deleteHomeHint: Choose another home page before deleting this one.
pages.deleteDescription: Categories, dishes and photos will remain in the shared catalog. After updating the publication, the deleted page’s link and QR code will no longer open the menu.
pages.limit: You can create up to {count} pages
pages.sharedCatalogHint: Category names, dishes and visibility are shared across pages. Choose categories and their order for each page.
pages.empty: Create a category or select an existing one from the catalog.

errors.PAGE_LIMIT: The page limit has been reached.
errors.INVALID_NAME: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
errors.INVALID_PATH: Enter a valid address such as /drinks. Reserved addresses are unavailable.
errors.PATH_TAKEN: Another page already uses this address.
errors.UNKNOWN: Could not save the page changes. Please try again.

game.title: Find a pair
game.hint: Turn over two cards and find matching treats.
game.result: All pairs found in {moves} moves. Your mascot is happy!
game.tryAgain: Almost! Remember these cards and try another pair.

mascot.title: Tamagotchi
mascot.hint: A little companion that brings your menu to life and reacts to guest choices.
mascot.previewHint: Try an emotion — your dish selection stays the same.
mascot.animationsHint: System reduced motion shows expressions without movement.

bun.name: Bun
bun.description: A warm personality in a little chef’s hat.

mochi.name: Mochi
mochi.description: A shy little sweet with leafy ears and a soft bounce.

pepper.name: Pepper
pepper.description: A playful dancer with a spark and a big smile.

happy.title: Great choice!
happy.description: The dish is in your selection.

selection.title: My selection
selection.showWaiter: Show this list to your waiter when you are ready.
selection.removedFromMenu: This item has left the menu. Remove it from your list.
selection.notOrder: This is a list to discuss with your waiter, not a placed order.
selection.empty: Nothing selected yet. Add a dish from the menu or recommendations.

recommendations.title: What to try
recommendations.empty: The restaurant has not added recommendations for this page yet.

publish.title: Publish menu
publish.description: Guests see the published version. Editor changes appear on the link after you update the publication.
publish.permanent: The subdomain is fixed on first publication. A page’s QR code stays valid while its path stays the same.
publish.saved: Your menu is live and the project is in Archive. Open the editor from there to update your menu without taking it offline.
publish.qrDescription: Download a QR code for printing or share a link to the published menu.
publish.homeQrHint: This QR opens the home page. Updating prices, dishes or photos keeps it valid — there is no need to print it again.
publish.pageQrHint: This QR opens a specific page. Changing its address or deleting it and updating the publication will stop the old QR from opening that page.
publish.updateHint: Your changes will appear at the same address. The home page QR stays the same — no need to replace printed materials.
publish.availabilityHint: The QR opens your menu while the project is published. Unpublishing temporarily disables access.
publish.qrUnavailable: The published menu is unavailable. Reload the editor and check its publication status.

errors.INVALID_SLUG: Use 3–24 Latin letters, numbers and hyphens, and choose an address that is not reserved.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This address is taken. Choose another.
errors.SLUG_IMMUTABLE: This menu already has a permanent address. Reload the editor.
errors.EMPTY_MENU: Add at least one visible dish with a name and price in a visible category. Enable the menu section.
errors.INVALID_MENU: Check menu categories, dishes and prices.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: Check your menu photos: use uploaded images or web URLs.
errors.PUBLISH_IN_PROGRESS: Publication is already in progress. Wait and try again.
errors.DRAFT_CHANGED: The menu changed during publication. Try updating again.
errors.PUBLISH_CANCELLED: Publication was cancelled. Reload the page.
errors.NOT_PUBLISHABLE: This project cannot currently be published.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this project.
errors.CONFIG_ERROR: Menu publication is not yet configured on the server.
errors.COPY_FAILED: Could not copy the link. Copy the address manually.
errors.UNKNOWN: Could not publish the menu. Please try again.

publish.fixedAddress: This address is reserved for this menu.
publish.pagesError: Could not load published page addresses.
